# Phase 4 synthetic telemetry fixture

This fixture describes the offline input contract for
`scripts/phase4_telemetry.py`. It contains reviewed summaries only: no prompts,
commands, report bodies, model output, credentials, arbitrary paths, or thread
identities. The reducer emits one owner-private aggregate per run/cell.

Use `tests/test_phase4_telemetry.py` for executable synthetic coverage. The
fixture is not a live evaluator and cannot establish host quality, consultation
benefit, or adaptive-strategy quality.
